name: Titsui impersonator
description: A blue-skinned, four-armed rakshasa who impersonates Titsui and Sidisi to recruit Nishang and later controls his body through a piece of his soul.

timeline.summary: Nishang awakens as an undead sibsig and meets what appears to be Titsui, who says Sidisi saved them both.
timeline.quote: I was wounded, mortally, but I was saved by the only one who may have loved our master more than us: Sidisi.

timeline.summary: Titsui explains the plan: Nishang will attend Dauna's ceremony for the newly undead carrying poisons from Sidisi in his new arm.
timeline.quote: Poisons gathered by Sidisi during her tenure of service to our master

timeline.summary: Sidisi appears and Nishang swears to serve, offering a piece of his soul to seal the pact.
timeline.quote: I will give anything and everything to bring back all that we've lost. I swear to serve.

timeline.summary: In an alley, Nishang doubts Titsui's story and learns that his friend was killed by a Sultai priest; the figure is revealed to be a rakshasa.
timeline.quote: revealing the monstrous form of a rakshasa beneath.

timeline.summary: Nishang helps a boy to his feet and realizes sibsig can feel and are like the living, but the rakshasa takes control of his body.
timeline.quote: The rakshasa was controlling him, totally and completely.

timeline.summary: Nishang enters the pool and the poison from his arm spreads, killing hundreds of sibsig.
timeline.quote: the poison expanded, turning what was once tender blue a violent orchid.

relations.note: a rakshasa who takes Sidisi's form and carries out her plan
relations.quote: his form shifts once again to Sidisi

relations.note: plots to kill the necromancers, sibsig and tree
relations.quote: to kill the traitorous necromancers that desecrate our Silumgar's legacy.

pages_say.description: A blue-skinned, four-armed rakshasa who impersonates Titsui and Sidisi to recruit Nishang and later controls his body through a piece of his soul.
